Chat request with tool_choice set to required forces the model to call a tool

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"What is the weather today?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\",\"tool_choice\":\"required\",\"tools\":[{\"function\":{\"description\":\"Get the current weather for a given location\",\"name\":\"get_weather\",\"parameters\":{\"properties\":{\"location\":{\"description\":\"The city name\",\"type\":\"string\"}},\"required\":[\"location\"],\"type\":\"object\"}},\"type\":\"function\"}]}", ChatCompletionRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.chat(req)
    println(result.choices)
    println(result.choices.first().message.toolCalls)
    println(result.choices.first().message.toolCalls?.first()?.function?.name)
    println(result.choices.first().finishReason)
}
```
